context: A dad introduces hobbies to his son
purpose: Teach: ドキュメント/ゴム/サム/回想/カタカナ/方言/弓/虎

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、テレビでドキュメント番組やってるぞ。
lines.en: Hey Sho, there's a documentary on TV right now.
lines.style: Casual, dad-lounging tone. Leans back into the couch. Warmth without agenda—just inviting him in. Easy pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ゴム鉄砲のおもちゃ作る話?
lines.en: Is it the one about making rubber-band guns?
lines.style: Quick, bright leap forward—genuine curiosity. Eyes light up. Not overthinking it, just following interest. Small hopeful lift at the end.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いや、職人のサムさんの回想だ。
lines.en: No, this one's about a craftsman named Sam—stories from his life.
lines.style: Gentle redirect, no letdown in tone. Still warm. Settles back into the moment. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもしろい!カタカナ多いから、よくわからない時もあるけど。
lines.en: Cool! There's so much katakana, sometimes I don't catch all of it.
lines.style: Genuine interest mixed with honest admission. No embarrassment—just stating the fact. Engaged despite the challenge. Comfortable honesty.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さんの故郷の方言、出てこないかな。
lines.en: I wonder if they'll use my hometown's dialect at all…
lines.style: Soft, introspective. Eyes drift slightly away—touching something personal. Quiet, wondering tone. Not quite nostalgia, not quite hope. Trails off gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Sudden pivot—excited energy. Brightness breaks through. Not connected to what came before, but that's the eight-year-old mind. Genuine spark. Quick, declarative.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 動物園で、虎、見たいって言ってたな。
lines.en: You were talking about seeing the tigers at the zoo just the other day.
lines.style: Gentle, amused observation. Dad-remembering-small-things tone. Warm, affectionate tease underneath. No correction, just noticing. Close and knowing.
